reviews.title: Tapping to download a bill doesn’t do anything. There is no reason left to keep using this app.
reviews.text:
The only reason I had left to keep using this slow and frustrating app was to easily download my bills as PDFs. For the past few months, tapping to Download a bill doesn’t seem to do anything.

WORKAROUND:  After tapping to Download a bill (and nothing seeming to happen), I can find the PDF of the bill if I use the Apple "Files" app - though the PDF is in a strange location, and this is far from intuitive or easy for a "normal" iPhone user.

Under Browse > On My iPhone > My BT there is a list of files with strange names and types (.json, .sqlite, .pen, .crt, .log). The .pdf file(s) in that list are the bill(s) I have clicked to download in the MyBT app.

I can then click on the PDF file (or click the 3 dots menu to "Select" and click on multiple PDF files) to then access the "share sheet" with its icon - and then choose where to copy it or which app to send it to in the usual way.

I do have to remember that this will copy the file(s) so I have to go back in to the "Files" app and delete the PDF(s) from the My BT folder after successfully opening or saving them elsewhere. Otherwise the PDFs will sit taking up storage space on my phone unnecessarily.

PLEASE get this fault fixed asap.

As I only have the basics from BT (broadband and landline) the app does all I need.
HOWEVER...The app. randomly logs me out every few months, before I can get back in I have to enter >ALL< my login details again, including a new PIN. As the BT app. does not communicate with the Passwords app that means I have to switch between the two apps to obtain and enter my login details.
I have tried using biometrics but that is even worse as the app (at that time) then insisted I use two-factor authentication.
These failings are REALLY ANNOYING, my banking apps don't behave like this (and I have a lot more to lose should anybody hack in) so why can't BT follow the banks' lead and give us something which does what the customer wants rather than what it thinks the customer needs?
Others have made similar comments, which makes me wonder whether BT actually read and take note of feedback.

UPDATE.
BT have again changed the app., I had to login AGAIN, get a passcode by email, enter a telephone number that will always be available, get another passcode by text then enter a PIN of my choosing.
As I said previously, unlike just about every other app., the BT app. doesn't directly interface to the passwords app. meaning logging in is a faff and very time consuming.
Does anybody at BT actually read these reviews? Has it ever heard of KISS? KEEP IT SIMPLE, STUPID!🤬

reviews.title: Chris williams
reviews.text: My father passed away, so i phoned up bt to change the account from my dads name to my mums. I was told i had to phone up before  april to renew as the contract was comming to an end. I spent 5 hours speaking to various assistants yesterday on my day off, and have got absolutely nowhere. Problems your end and general incompitence, i was promised my an advisor late lastnight that they would call my mother and assist her only for her to be told they will only deal with me, this is not my account, it is all in her name, i was just helping her out as she is elderly, nothing is in my name its all in hers yet they refused to deal with her, all we want is to renew and this seems to be an impossible task, genuinely the worst customer service i have ever experienced in my life, i do not for the life of me understand how such a simple request can result in hours and hours of stress and wasted time when we as a family are going through a bad enough time as it is. One word springs to mind for this review…..appalling!

reviews.title: No, and very poor Broadband/ landline
reviews.text:
The service re faults is disgusting / Dec23rd 22 I lost my Broadband and landline, the landline was restored 6th Jan 23. My Broadband was off for many days after this date and after many complaints Broadband was restored to 6mbps (very poor) effecting my Bt sport. Up and to today 25th Jan. I’ve had 8mbps it has now increased to 20 mbps. The Only person who has been able to help me is a lady called Hayley, she has been doing all she can to get me back to normal ( 38/40 mbps. The latest is that it will be back to normal tomorrow 26th Jan 23. Hayley’s manager has also been trying to get this fault repaired, I understand it is Openreach that are at fault but you have to agree this is not acceptable. I have only just changed my contract with Bt who may I say gave me the impression I would save a lot on my Broadband, I’m not sure what they meant by a lot? As you can imagine I’m a very unhappy person and being elderly and on a pension does’nt help. Percy Shackson.
  
   31st Jan 23.   Engineer visited, remade all inside and outside connections and tested incoming line and for speed all ok other than I used to get 38mb/s now 34 mb/s
   So I suppose all in all things back to almost normal but it has taken over a month.
    I just Dread having another fault in the future.
